title: Add Anthropic support to Advanced Paste

status.label: Blocked
status.detail: Current-head validation at 73d4c3f confirmed that the Advanced Paste project cannot restore because the configured PowerToys Azure Artifacts feed returns HTTP 401 for Anthropic. The failure occurs before compilation. Manual remediation: authenticate the configured feed using approved repository tooling, or make the Anthropic package available in that feed, then rerun the standard Advanced Paste restore/build.

next_action: Authenticate the configured Azure Artifacts feed with approved tooling or make the Anthropic package available there, then rerun the standard Advanced Paste restore/build.

blockers.detail: A clean local checkout pinned to the live upstream head 73d4c3ffc22b164d78248668eea21390baae362c failed `dotnet restore` for AdvancedPaste.csproj with NU1301 because the configured Azure Artifacts feed returned HTTP 401 while retrieving Anthropic. The failure occurs before compilation.
blockers.remediation: Authenticate the configured Azure Artifacts feed using approved repository tooling, or make the Anthropic package available in that feed, then rerun the standard Advanced Paste restore/build.
